verdict.rationale: Connection pooling is a fair question for a hosted Postgres platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents a built-in pooler or handling of thousands of concurrent connections. The connecting guide only says there are 'several ways to connect' for frontend, backend and serverless code, and Read Replica load balancing is a different capability, so neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, a built-in connection pooler handles thousands of concurrent connections without me operating my own pgbouncer or proxy
